<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1044
Claimant:
Phillip Marshall
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2024-02-28
Claimant reported a hit while turning left at an intersection and says the other vehicle came through on a green light
as they were completing the turn. Reported injury is a concussion with headaches and dizziness, which is a plausible
result for an impact of this kind.
2024-06-15
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time and that the collision
happened as described. Photos taken at the scene match the account given so far.
2024-06-26
Claimant is not represented by a lawyer and handled the first call directly. Account given matches the initial report in
eevry detail, including the order of events and the position of both vehicles.
2024-07-17
Other driver confirms the collision occurred as described and does not dispute the sequence. Driver is named on the
policy and the policy was in force at the time of loss.
2024-08-12
Vehicle damage is mostly in line with the described impact to the driver side and front quarter panel. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records, and nothing suggests the damage predates
the coverage start.
2024-08-27
Medical records show the concussion was diagnosed and treated, and recovery has taken somewhat longer than
usual for this injury. No earlier injury to the same area of the head or neck is known from prior records.
2024-09-06
Claimant gave the same account in the follow-up call and again at the inspection. Nothing in the statements has
changed on any point discussed so far.
2024-09-26
File is progressing on the standard path with the medical treatment still ongoing. Next step is to request updated
treatment notes and set a review once the claimant's provider issues a current prognosis.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
